item.title: Trump launches flurry of endorsements en route to Texas visit
item.description: President Donald Trump on Friday fired off a flurry of candidate endorsements for primary races in Texas en route to an afternoon visit to the Lone Star State.Trump took to Truth Social Friday morning sending off endorsements in congressional and statewide races in Texas. Notably absent from the endorsements, the hotly contested race for U.S. Senate. item.title: Travis County Fire Marshal’s Office asks for help identifying suspect in arson investigation
item.description: The Travis County Fire Marshal’s Office is asking for help identifying a suspect and the suspect's vehicle in connection with an arson investigation. The county said on Wednesday, Jan. 8, around 8:30 p.m., fire marshals responded to a vehicle fire in the 9000 block of Decker Lane.After investigating the scene, they determined someone intentionally set the fire. item.description: There are some new Austin ordinances: one for targeting loud engine noise, and another for the city to keep its spending in check.One of the things of note is a city audit ordinance. This stems from the tax rate election last year that Austinites overwhelmingly voted against. item.title: Texas heat wave may have set record for nation’s hottest winter temp ever recorded
item.description: A sprawling area of high pressure has sent temperatures soaring across the southern U.S., pushing temperatures more than 20 degrees above average for this time of year in some places.

item.title: Texas DPS installs license plate readers across Central Texas
item.description: Earlier this month, DPS installed license plate readers along several state rights-of-ways. Now, we’re learning which agencies can access that data.The City of Austin ended its license plate reader program last summer over privacy concerns. But while Austin no longer participates, many neighboring agencies do.More than 120 agencies across the state have access to the DPS database, including departments in Cedar Park, Hutto, Marble Falls, New Braunfels, Round Rock, Elgin, Kyle, Bastrop, and Burne

item.title: Former Austin ISD campus being transformed into affordable housing in East Austin
item.description: A former Austin ISD campus that closed years ago is being transformed into affordable housing, with a groundbreaking celebration held on Friday. The school-to-housing redevelopment is officially underway at the former Anita Ferrales Coy School grounds in East Austin. "This is going to be a multi-phase redevelopment. item.description: Police are investigating after a man was found shot to death in a homeless encampment in northeast Austin Saturday morning.Austin police said the incident happened in the 900 block of East Braker Lane.Police spokesperson Jeremy Fisher said officers were called to the location around 8:10 a.m. Saturday, where they located the man with gunshot wounds.Fisher said the shooting was believed to have happened overnight.The victim's identity has not yet been released.
